meta.name: canyon_cliff_pueblos
meta.prompt: Two cliff-dwelling pueblos facing each other across a narrow desert canyon, adobe rooms stacked up the rock, joined by a single rope-and-plank bridge over the drop.

programs.brief: A long rope-and-plank suspension bridge spanning across the deep desert canyon between two cliffs, with sagging timber catwalk, twisted rope railings, and heavy log anchor pylons embedded in the rock on both sides.

A circular subterranean stone kiva ceremonial pit set flush into the cliff ledge, with flat log ceiling beams, a central roof opening with an upright timber ladder protruding, and a low ritual stone bench.
